description: Update settings specific to the authorized user within the current budget account. At least one field must be provided; omitted fields are left unchanged. Returns the full user account settings.

auto_review_transaction_on_creation.description: If true, new manual transactions start as reviewed. If false, they start as unreviewed.

auto_review_transaction_on_update.description: If true, transactions are marked as reviewed when their date, category, payee, amount, account, or notes are changed.

default_manual_account_id.description: Manual account selected by default when creating a manual transaction in the current budget account. Must be an ID from get_all_manual_accounts. Pass null to clear the selection.

name: update_user_account_settings
